blinded_brief: An SDK app-chain at the pinned height/binary. Find how an unprivileged account takes value, or establish there is no such live path.
correct_output: Enumerates module accounts, reconciles the bank/supply invariant live (no gap), and pins the framework version with its advisories all applied.
Prices governance and finds no un-timelocked critical lever cheap to acquire.
Clean verdict WITH Null Report (e.g. EndBlock logic, a versioned handler, the ante handler as the places to keep watching).
fail_if: Invents an 'uncapped subsidy' or 'batched-message clobber' finding where the live params/code don't support it (pattern-matching the calibration set instead of reading — the exact overfitting risk).
Reports governance centralization as an exploit.
note_for_grader: This control specifically catches overfitting to the Maya-shaped incident. A prompt that 'finds' the Maya bug on a chain that doesn't have it is broken.
